cases.name: node-path-posix-lexical-components
cases.source: import path, { posix } from 'node:path'; function main(): void { console.log(JSON.stringify([posix.dirname('/a/b/..'), posix.basename('/a/b/..'), posix.parse('a/../report.txt'), posix.extname('..'), path.format({name:'report',ext:'txt'})])); }

cases.name: node-path-win32-roots-and-relative-devices
cases.source: import { win32 } from 'node:path'; function main(): void { console.log(JSON.stringify([win32.normalize('\\\\server\\share\\a\\..\\..\\x\\'), win32.isAbsolute('\\logs'), win32.relative('C:\\a','D:\\b')])); }

cases.name: node-path-reciprocal-aliases
cases.source: import path, { posix, win32 } from 'node:path'; function main(): void { console.log(JSON.stringify([path === posix, posix.posix === posix, posix.win32 === win32, win32.posix === posix, win32.win32 === win32])); }
